about: Where the NSE/BSE data comes from and whether it could be reached. Access facts only: no rates, charges or tax values are recorded here. Every status below was observed from a cloud session on checked_at; re-check before relying on it.

rules: Identify honestly: one fixed User-Agent, no browser impersonation.
Send no Cookie, Referer, Origin or X-Requested-With header; never call undocumented internal endpoints.
A site that refuses us (403, empty reply) is recorded as blocked, not worked around.
Downloaded files are untrusted data: parsed, never executed, and kept out of git.

sources.title: NSE equity bhavcopy, legacy daily format
sources.evidence: Zip archives returned for 2012-01-02 (1526 rows), 2018-01-02 (1856 rows) and 2020-01-02 (1956 rows); columns include SYMBOL, SERIES, CLOSE, TOTTRDQTY, ISIN. NIFTYBEES present in all three.
uncertainties: One cautious retry through fetch.py at 2026-10-28T11:26:57Z (Phase 2) was again closed by the server without a response; no further requests were made to this host.

Later on 2026-10-28 (about 11:23 UTC) the server closed the connection without a response, to both curl and Python, for the 2018-01-02 file it had served earlier; the proxy logged no failure for this host. Possibly rate limiting after the Phase 0 checks. Retry gently before relying on it.
The last date this format was published (before the UDiFF switch) is not verified.
Redistribution terms not reviewed: keep the files in the local cache only.

uncertainties: One cautious retry through fetch.py at 2026-10-28T11:26:57Z (Phase 2) was again closed by the server without a response; no further requests were made to this host.

Later on 2026-10-28 (about 11:23 UTC) the server closed the connection without a response, to both curl and Python, for the 2018-01-02 file it had served earlier; the proxy logged no failure for this host. Possibly rate limiting after the Phase 0 checks. Retry gently before relying on it.
The first date this format is available is not verified.

sources.title: BSE equity bhavcopy, UDiFF daily format
sources.evidence: CSV for 2026-10-27 (856277 bytes) with ISIN, TckrSymb and OHLC columns. Phase 2 (2026-10-28): verified files for every sampled session from 2024-08-01 to 2026-10-01; refused (HTML page) for sampled dates in 2018, where the legacy layout answered.
uncertainties: The exact first day of this layout lies between 2024-07-01 and 2024-08-01.

sources.title: BSE equity bhavcopy with ISIN, legacy format
sources.evidence: Zip archive for 2018-01-02; the 2012-01-02 URL returned an HTML page with HTTP 200, not data. Phase 2 (2026-10-28): files verified for every sampled session from 2018-01-01 to 2024-07-01; refused for 2024-08-01, when the UDiFF layout answered instead. PREVCLOSE was not restated on ETF unit-split ex-dates (for example NIFTYBEES 2019-12-19: PREVCLOSE 1292.95, close 129.90).
uncertainties: Earliest available date is somewhere between 2012 and 2018.
The exact last day of this layout lies between 2024-07-01 and 2024-08-01.
A file lists only instruments that traded that day; absence is not delisting.

sources.title: NIFTY indices daily closing snapshot (price indices)
sources.evidence: CSV for 27-10-2026 with 168 index rows: open, high, low, close, P/E, P/B, dividend yield. Price index only: no total-return column.
uncertainties: Only one date was checked; how far back the daily files go is not verified.

sources.title: NIFTY 50 current constituents
sources.evidence: CSV with 50 rows: company, industry, symbol, series, ISIN.
uncertainties: Current list only, not point-in-time; not usable for historical universes.

sources.title: NIFTY 50 Total Returns Index history
sources.evidence: Daily_Snapshot TRI file names returned an HTML page with HTTP 200, not data. The history page's data endpoint is internal and was not used. The user downloads the CSV in a browser and imports it with india/tri.py.
uncertainties: Column names of the downloaded file are not known in advance; tri.py detects or is told them.
